I'd given up on drinking loose leaf teas because I absolutely hated the infusers I had. I decided to give it one more try so I purchased this set of tea balls. The set of six arrived in great condition - no dents at all.

The balls themselves are fine mesh and feature a long chain with a cup hook on the end. I've found that the chain is long enough to work even in my larger cups. The hooks stay in place so I don't have to go fish for the tea ball once the tea has steeped.

The closure on this type of tea ball is what made it great. It's a little latch that firmly fastens the two halves of the tea ball together with no escaping tea leaves. I simply fill half of the ball, fasten the latch, hook it onto my cup and I'm good to go. When I'm done steeping, it's a simple matter to open up the latch and dump the tea leaves out. The tea ball cleans up quickly and easily - something that my other infusers didn't do.

I am really happy with these tea balls and am thinking of buying a set or two to include in gifts for some of my tea-loving friends.

Bought this 6-pack of tea balls when my old ones started breaking after only a few months of use. I must say I was quite happy when I received them. They were smaller and rounder than the old balls, which had started to suffer from wrinkling and discoloration. I do not think the size difference will negatively impact my tea-brewing, as these can still hold quite a lot of tea inside. Overall, these balls are shapely and aesthetically pleasing.

Two other factors set these balls apart as a definite improvement over my old ones. First: they have a longer chain. This allows the balls to dangle more freely in a wider range of cup sizes. Second, and most importantly: the seal on these tea balls is very tight compared to any I have used before. Whereas leakage of smaller bits of tea leaves was a problem with the older balls, these new balls seem better able to contain all but the tiniest tea components. It is nice to finally own balls that do not spill their contents in unwanted places.

Overall an excellent product!

Unless you have a very thin cup, the hook is too small to fit on the edge of the cup. I will be making a small weight to attach to the hook in order to allow the hook to just dangle off the edge of the cup.

End of the line: I will be using these until they break, keeping a separate strainer to catch my tea floaties. If someone I know gets me something else that works better, I'll keep these as a backup.
